posed_centre.label: Posing dead centre
posed_centre.plain: The subject sits in the middle and looks straight at the lens, like it was told to hold still.
posed_centre.example: Think of a school photo, then think of a snapshot a friend took while you were mid-sentence.

look_for.default: the subject sits dead centre and faces the camera as if posing
look_for.animal: the animal sits dead centre and stares into the lens as if posing

posed_centre.fix_phrase: Off-centre, caught mid-moment, not looking at the camera.

too_clean.label: Too clean and smooth
too_clean.plain: Real fur clumps, sheds and catches dust; here it looks brushed by a computer. Skin gets the same treatment: no pores, no marks.
too_clean.example: Like a doll next to a living thing: nothing is out of place anywhere.

look_for.default: skin looks airbrushed or too clean, with no visible pores, marks or small flaws
look_for.animal: fur looks airbrushed, too even or too clean, with no clumps, stray hairs or dust

too_clean.fix_phrase: Visible pores, stray hairs, small marks and uneven texture.

generic_room.label: Stock-photo room
generic_room.plain: The room is the usual sunny window and wooden furniture set that appears in every generated picture.
generic_room.example: Like the fake living room in a furniture catalogue, where nobody has ever left a mug.

look_for.default: the room is a generic sunny window with wooden furniture and nothing personal in it

generic_room.fix_phrase: A specific, lived-in place with everyday clutter instead of a stock room.

painted_mess.label: Mess that looks drawn on
painted_mess.plain: Dirt, mess or wear is spread evenly and looks painted on, not something that built up over time.
painted_mess.example: Fake dirt on a costume versus the real scuffs on a shoe you have worn for years.

look_for.default: dirt, mess or wear looks evenly sprinkled or painted on rather than naturally built up

painted_mess.fix_phrase: Wear only where things really wear: edges, handles, folds and corners.

studio_light.label: Light too perfect
studio_light.plain: The light is soft and flattering everywhere, which does not fit the place. Real rooms have dull corners and mixed lamps.
studio_light.example: A portrait studio's glow in the middle of a messy kitchen.

look_for.default: the lighting is flawless, soft and even in a way that does not suit the place

studio_light.fix_phrase: Light that comes from what is really in the place, uneven, with some dark corners.

anatomy.label: Odd body parts
anatomy.plain: Hands, paws, eyes, teeth or ears look slightly wrong: extra fingers, merged toes, mismatched eyes.
anatomy.example: Count the fingers on a hand. A real hand always gives the same number.

look_for.default: hands, eyes, teeth or ears look wrong (extra or merged fingers, mismatched eyes)
look_for.animal: paws, eyes, teeth or ears look wrong (extra or merged toes, mismatched eyes, odd ears)

anatomy.fix_phrase: Correct anatomy: the right number of fingers or toes, matching eyes, natural teeth and ears.

artefacts.label: Glints, smears and melted details
artefacts.plain: Small areas look smeared or melted, or have odd shiny spots, where the picture ran out of detail.
artefacts.example: Like a thumbprint smudged across a wet drawing: fine from afar, wrong up close.

look_for.default: there are smears, melted details, odd glints or blurred patches that should be sharp

artefacts.fix_phrase: Clean, sharp small details with no smears, melting or stray glints.

bad_text.label: Garbled lettering
bad_text.plain: Any writing in the picture is jumbled or made of letter-like shapes that do not spell real words.
bad_text.example: A shop sign that says CAFFEEE OPEN in squiggles instead of a real name.

look_for.default: any visible writing is garbled, misspelled or made of letter-like shapes

bad_text.fix_phrase: No visible writing, or only short words that are spelled correctly.
